high_level_description: The image appears to be an album cover for the band Underworld's live album titled "Everything Everything." The design is minimalist and modern, featuring a grid of green squares with varying shades of green. The squares are arranged in a checkerboard pattern, creating a visually striking and somewhat abstract background. The text on the left side of the image reads "Underworld Live; EVERYTHING EVERYTHING" in a clean, sans-serif font. The text is white, which contrasts sharply with the green background, making it easily readable.
